body:
N-26 SLICE 4, PART 1: THE CORPUS AND THE SERIES TITLE ARE BUILT; BUILT, NOT WALKED, NOT MARKED (helper-n26s4, 15 Nov 2026). Branch task/N-26-slice4-context-shapes, one PR. Server only: no keeper, tags, refs schema, migration or phone; no network or look-up (fakes and recorded answers). I did not run `roadmap.py mark`: slices 3 and 5 and N-28 remain. The live credit (ARTE) is NOT built: see part 2, a decision for the lead.

CORPUS FIRST (its own commit, before any rule): tests/fixtures/n26_upload_corpus.json, read by tests/test_import_upload_corpus.py. 235 rows = the 114 recorded uploads of tests/fixtures/ytm (a new recording without a row fails a test) + 49 titles of the reader tests + 72 hand-written (live, op, ed, ost, session, by, in, at as ordinary words; Arabic, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Greek, Hebrew). Judged one by one: 182 negative (right today), 46 leftover (wrong before AND after, each with reason and owning task, asserted at today's reading), 7 fixed. RESULT: negative rows changed = 0. Mutation check (scratch): the first wide rules fail it: a bare "by" gives "Ed Sheeran - Stand By Me" the artist "Me" (also "Ben E. King - Stand By Me"); op/ed before a pipe gives "Chopin - Nocturne Op. 9 No. 2 | Piano" and "Beethoven ... Op. 67" the uploader; "live in" anywhere gives "We Live in Fear" the artist "We". Non-Latin rows are right today while textnorm.ascii_fold is still blind to them: a test names P2-25 and pins that (not fixed).

BUILT (a), the series credit (imports/uploads.py _series_credit): first segment ends in Opening or Ending (optional number, or the word alone), a pipe or a separator, then "<Song> by <Artist>" split on the LAST " by ". Recorded: "DAN DA DAN Opening | Otonoke by Creepy Nuts" (Crunchyroll) = Creepy Nuts / "Otonoke" / title; "DAN DA DAN Ending | TAIDADA by ZUTOMAYO" = ZUTOMAYO / "TAIDADA". Red first: the 7 fixed rows and 17 table rows failed on the old reader, every near miss passed on it.

DECIDED (yours to overrule): song = bare "Otonoke" (the series is context; a catalogue can match "Otonoke"); basis title, uploader kept; the dash after the label is read like the pipe (your list names it; the corpus permits it); a credit with a bracket, pipe or quote reads as before (a half-clean name would be a wrong TRUSTED artist); the abbreviations OP and ED are NOT read (they broke Op. 9 and Ed Sheeran; the recorded "DAN DA DAN Season 2 ED | Doukashiteru by WurtS | Netflix Anime" stays on its channel, a leftover row); a bare "by" is not read; "Death by Stereo" is cut at the last "by" (pinned KNOWN_LEFTOVER, N-28). Leftover rows also hold: three ARTE forms with a quoted song (single songs), "<Artist> performing "<Song>" Live on KCRW", a label's credit with a quoted song on the label's channel.

NOT CHECKED: no real stack, device or network (by rule); the yt-dlp path only through fakes; nothing is claimed walked. Docs: P2-songs-as-references.md (slice 4, as built; slice table), docs/19 (rule table), CHANGELOG.
